messages.subject: Re: geom_histogram is incorrect...!
parts:
Algorithm "decides" to bin 1970 with (1965, 1970], and not (1970, 1975]. See help file for `cut` function documentation (`right = TRUE`).

To see what is going on, you can try

data.frame(chch_agedist$year, 
           cutvals1 = cut(chch_agedist$year, breaks = seq(1850, 2010, by = 1)), 
           cutvals5 = cut(chch_agedist$year, breaks = seq(1850, 2010, by = 5)),
           cutvals5low = cut(chch_agedist$year, breaks = seq(1850, 2010, by = 5), right = TRUE)
           )

or change the way breaks are calculated

geom_histogram(alpha = 0.3, breaks = seq(1850,2010, by = 1)) +


Cheers,
Roman

On Wed, Jun 8, 2016 at 1:56 AM, summer71 <sch...@gmail.com> wrote:


Hi all,

My data looks like this (attached - no tenure column)
head(chch_agedist)

 age_of_property year_of_construction tenure age year decades
47 90 1925 Rented 90 1925 1920s
48 38 1977 Owned 38 1977 1970s
49 80 1935 Owned 80 1935 1930s
50 40 1975 Owned 40 1975 1970s
51 2 2013 Owned 2 2013 2010s
52 60 1955 Owned 60 1955 1950s




I'm trying to graph age distribution using density and histogram


median(chch_agedist$year)
# [1] 1973


agedist <- ggplot(chch_agedist, aes(year, ..density..)) +
  geom_density(fill = "#EAB352", alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", size = 0.5) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.3, breaks = seq(1850,2010, by = 5)) +
  ylim(0, 0.020) + ylab("Density") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1850,2010,20)) + xlab("Year of construction") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1973), colour = c("#EAB352"), linetype = "longdash") +
  annotate("text", label = c("Median: 1973", "n = 133"), size = 3, x = c(1973, 1865), y = c(0.020, 0.0170)) +
  theme(legend.justification = c(0,1), legend.position = c(0.05, 0.95), text = element_text(size = 10), axis.title = element_text(size = 10))



this gives me this..







I have median at 1973 but the histogram density bar is missing?

I manually check the data and there are quite a few that falls into 1970 - 1975..


Please help!


Kind regards,


--

messages.subject: Re: geom_histogram is incorrect...!
parts:
I broke the command down and started rebuilding it, and it looked alright
with just:

x<-ggplot(chch_agedist,aes(x=year,y=..density..))+geom_histogram(breaks=seq
(1850,2010,5),alpha=0.3)+geom_density(fill="#EAB352",alpha=0.5,linetype="do
tted",size=0.5)

But then I did:
x+ylim(0,0.020)

And got the result summer71 saw. It looks to me like the ylim drops the
bars which exceed its maximum value, which includes the bar for 1970-1975.
So just dropping the call to ylim fixes it.

Ron.

messages.subject: Re: geom_histogram is incorrect...!
parts:
Hi there,
yes, ylim excludes data outside of that range. To just shrink the axes'
range, one needs to use coord_cartesian, to my knowledge.
Best
Brian
